proposals.evidence: Ordered come + be components: DEDR5270 explicitly gives Gondi vā-/vāy- come. Survey vā-si-ma- responses contain that lexical come root followed by the separately identified auxiliary; their full elicited forms are retained. DEDR4778 supplies Gondi man-/matt- be/remain as the second component. Construction checked: [Southern Gondi grammar](https://www.gondwana.in/sites/www.gondwana.in/files/pdf-files/SGondi%20%28Aheri%29%20Grammar%20final%202000%20%28Unicode%29.pdf), pp.24–25; this is a comparison across survey lects, not a claim that every response is Aheri.
